technology_name: Next-Generation Starter Culture for Kerala's Traditional Fermented Food
institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
problem_solved: Variations in culinary quality, unpredictable results, and elevated risks of microbial contamination associated with traditional back-slop fermentation practices.
description: A reliable, standardized, and ready-to-use modular microbial starter culture blend derived from authentic traditional idli and dosa batters. The formulation relies on isolated beneficial bacteria chosen for optimized acidification, active gas production, and distinct textural properties. Strains are validated via advanced genome sequencing to ensure performance, absolute safety, and potential probiotic value, offering a clean-label alternative free from synthetic additives or preservatives.
applications:
• Commercial production of packaged starter cultures for household and industrial culinary spaces

• Formulation of clean-label, functional probiotic foods and health supplements

• Standardized supply chains for commercial batter manufacturers and corporate food brands

• Grassroots micro-enterprise and rural development models based on bio-input distribution
contact_person: Dr. Aparna Shankar & Dr. Sabu Thomas
